description: The M_beta spectrum on V_(2,1) under the convention-D trace. M_beta is undefined in the corpus (2 occurrences, both inside the claim); the only universal beta-decay matrix the conditional-on block defines is Delta_beta = (h/2)*I, whose spectrum is the REPEATED REAL eigenvalue h/2 - a scalar matrix has no eigenphase. None of the four named transfer matrices has det = 1, which is necessary for a spectrum {e^{+-i.alpha}}, so all four are excluded by determinant rather than by the qou-pdix rationality invariant (which covers only the braid image). Separately: z_D = q^3/(q^2+1) IS a seminormal sigma_2 diagonal entry identically, so z_D + d2 = h splits the Hecke differential across the V_(2,1) diagonal - convention C does not do this.

checks.why: nn->mix and mix->pp give the same matrix

checks.name: delta_beta_spectrum_is_repeated_h_over_2

checks.why: Hecke unimodularity

checks.why: -(1 + h^2/4) <= -1 < 0 for every real h, so never 1

checks.name: zC_differs_from_d1
checks.why: convention C is NOT the V_(2,1)-adapted parameter

checks.name: sigma2_satisfies_hecke
checks.why: sigma2^2 = h*sigma2 + 1

checks.why: |trace| = 2 exactly at q = (1+sqrt5)/2, the ellipticity boundary

checks.why: ladder phase -> 0 at q=1: a different classical limit entirely

checks.name: elliptic_phase_far_from_ladder_phase_at_q0

data.verdict: DERIVED. Delta_beta = (h/2)I has spectrum {h/2, h/2}: a repeated real eigenvalue, no eigenphase. All four named transfer matrices fail det = 1. The spectrum claim of prop:q-beta-cos-resummation is not a property of any matrix the corpus defines. Scope-(b) for the four named matrices, invariant = determinant.
